changelog: New voice command "summarize" — say it alone while dictating (or "সারাংশ করো" in Bengali) and your whole dictated message is condensed to 2-3 short lines of key points, like the app's Summary button but hands-free in WhatsApp or Messenger. It needs at least 20 words of text, and "undo rewrite" brings back the original long message. The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 47 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
